assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only yuru-camp:kagamihara-nadeshiko@manga#reviewed-synthesis-document03, the active_provisional Document03 synthesis of Kagamihara Nadeshiko (Japanese main manga V01-V19) at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis. The project's corpus map, analytical method and character reconstruction specification were read for method, authority and scope only; the specification's statement that no subject has a readiness determination is an input, not a conclusion. The volume readings, the five longitudinal ledgers, Documents02 and 04-06, 10 and 12, the checkpoints and the Japanese source images are not curated evidence on this subject, and nothing is borrowed from them. No anime, anthology or post-V19 material is included, and the evaluator inspected no primary source.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Japanese main manga V01-V19 as read through the six checkpoints and the V19 transaction, with the dated post-V19 complements placed in their V04-V07 and V13 story epochs. States are split at the located transitions: the V01 repaired invitation, V04-V05 work, the V06 counsel request, the V07 solo trip, the V16-V17 Gunma journey and the V19 household reunion. The V16 spring special is placed before the Gunma chapters, and bonus-strip chronology is not fixed. No default state is set, and no state after V19 is established.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit, including the owner calibration rulings; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: Document03 states three bounded inferences about Nadeshiko (Kagamihara Nadeshiko): she turns interest into revisable activity; her hospitality is participation distributed across other people's tasks; and her solo preference adds to group life rather than replacing it (§9). Each is tested against located counterevidence: the missed bus connection and museum event (E16-03, E16-10), the wrong bicycle turn (E16-12), the registration-deadline confusion (E17-03), the burnt carrot (E07-03), and the V19 meal her father cooks while she sleeps (E19-12). The account rejects both a helpless novice and an indispensable caregiver. B is rejected: the monograph says the first pattern has moderate confidence and "is not a prediction that every curiosity will be enacted or every plan repaired" (§9). It gives no account of when interest becomes action rather than a wish (the V03 lamp postponed, the fuller museum return left a wish), and it says the rival explanation from camping subject matter, episodic comedy and ensemble structure "remains substantial" (§9). Not knowing which reading explains a choice is insufficiency, not productive uncertainty. D would understate a dedicated, independently reviewed account whose inferences support narrow extrapolation.

The monograph locates Nadeshiko's (Kagamihara Nadeshiko's) changes and their conditions: help received from Rin (Shima Rin) and an invitation repaired in V01 (E01-01-03); gear desire turned into a saving plan in V03 (A, E03-03); a work lead in V04 and actual delivery work in V05 (E04-04, E05-08); a request for counsel about solo camping in V06 (E06-04); the actual V07 solo trip with a mixed appraisal and a wish to alternate solo and group trips (E07-01-04); a modular Oigawa interval in V11 that is not a second solo overnight (A); V16-V17 research with consequential errors (E16-03-12, E17-01-14); and a V19 welcome she organizes but does not cook (E19-12-13). §10 gives an explicit state through V19. Story epochs are kept apart from later admission dates. A is rejected: the V03 and V10-V13 strands are largely ANALYSIS_EXTRACTED, V19 is not the manga's ending, and the account gives no mechanism that would predict the next state. C would understate a located sequence with named conditions (money, work, transport, family logistics) and an explicit through-V19 state.

The monograph gives short verified Japanese lines from Nadeshiko (Kagamihara Nadeshiko), each with its recipient and the work it does (§8): 気がむいたら to Rin (Shima Rin) as an optional invitation, with familiar リンちゃん; energetic polite ばっちりです!! to a workplace adult; ありがとうございますっ!! to a resident who gives her tea; the tentative あったかい…とか？ to Ena (Saitō Ena); 接客楽しいよ and 相談があるんだ to Rin by telephone; playful elderly-host diction お姉ちゃんもどうじゃ？ to children at a campsite; the hedge たぶんうまく焼けたと思うよ and the admission やりすぎた!!; the playfully ceremonious 交互にやってきたいと思います to Aoi (Inuyama Aoi); まだ想像上の食べ物なんだよ… to Ena and Ema (Mizunami Ema); 自慢のお姉ちゃんです to Rin and Ayano (Toki Ayano); お父さんごめんねー to her father; and the private 料理系だったら 私でもだませる？. It warns that a polite form among friends is not distance and that an exclamation is not confidence. B is rejected: the monograph says voice evidence is selected, not a census, and that self-reference, sustained conflict, unfamiliar formal settings, lengthy workplace exchanges and negative affect are undercovered (§10); it gives no distributional rule. D would understate about fourteen verified lines across at least nine recipients and several modes.

Ordinary activity is dense and attributed: short-term New Year card delivery with address checking (E05-08); gear desire against price and a saving plan (A, E03-03); cooking trials with mixed results (E07-03); rail, bus and walking itineraries and their failures (E16-03, E16-10); a bicycle outing with a wrong turn (E16-12); taxi and registration logistics (E17-03); adapting recipes from her father and from Aoi (Inuyama Aoi) (E17-06, E17-11); and V19 household arrangements, including a freezer constraint, a request for her mother's consent, sweet coffee for Sakura (Kagamihara Sakura), and falling asleep at the bath (E19-12-13). The account names who else does each task. A is rejected: the monograph says complete wages, household finances, every gear acquisition and every preparation decision are unavailable (§10), customer-service enjoyment is only her report (E06-04), and the monograph does not treat school life. C would understate an ordinary-life record that is located, specific about other hands, and includes her errors.

The monograph separates Nadeshiko's (Kagamihara Nadeshiko's) relations by direction and history (§7). Rin (Shima Rin): she proposes, accepts help, provides food, asks counsel, worries and tolerates separate plans, while Rin's own initiative is kept (E01-02, E02-02, E09-03, E18-10). Ayano (Toki Ayano): she is a bridge whose connection gains its own content (E05-07, E18-10/13). Ena (Saitō Ena): sometimes the inviter, sometimes the recipient of knowledge and help, and Ena's refusals stand (E04-04, E05-09, E17-04/12). Aoi (Inuyama Aoi): receives her mixed solo report and supplies a recipe (E07-04, E17-12). Ema (Mizunami Ema): hosting a person with her own practice, without credit for Ema's choices (E16-05-09, E17-03-14). Family members appear as separate hands (§6), and strangers at a campsite approach first (E07-03). A is rejected: the Chiaki (Ōgaki Chiaki) strand is thin, Mei (Nakatsugawa Mei) is barely covered, the V14 Ema opening is ANALYSIS_EXTRACTED, and no rule says how she weighs one relation against another. C would understate a directed, knowledge-aware account across at least seven relations.

Nadeshiko's (Kagamihara Nadeshiko's) states are mostly shown outwardly. The monograph gives one verified private line, 料理系だったら 私でもだませる？, in bonus-strip mode (E19-19), notes her regret at the missed museum event (E16-10) and a fear of a nighttime walk (§10), and keeps sadness at a trip's end and a hesitant request to camp again at analysis level only (A: E09-03, E11-03). It explicitly declines a total interior account (§8) and assigns other characters' private thoughts (Rin's (Shima Rin's) admiration, Ema's (Mizunami Ema's) doubts) away from her. C is rejected: specialist interpretation of her inner life is not offered and most affect anchors are unverified Japanese. E would understate several located states that a model must respect.

Friction is low-amplitude and located: an early invitation too forceful for Rin (Shima Rin), followed by apology and an optional proposal (E01-02); Ena's (Saitō Ena's) refusal to join the club left standing (E05-09); rejecting an over-rushed itinerary in favor of rethinking (E16-03); and nearly giving up on a taxi until Ema (Mizunami Ema) urges her to call (E17-03). C is rejected: the monograph says sustained conflict is undercovered (§10) and does not cover her response to anger or rupture. E would understate repeated mismatch-and-repair episodes.

Only local acts with an ethical aspect appear: asking her mother's consent before using the stored dumplings (E19-13), apologizing to her father for the cooking he did (E19-12), and a deliberate food-credibility deception in a bonus strip (E19-19). The discovery row claims no ethics dimension, and no deliberation is depicted. D would overclaim moral reasoning that is not in the evidence; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the located acts.

The monograph distinguishes several modes of play with named recipients: playful elderly-host diction to the children (お姉ちゃんもどうじゃ？, E07-03), shared laughter at her own burnt carrot (E07-03), making uncertainty comic and shareable (まだ想像上の食べ物なんだよ…, E17-01), ceremonious phrasing inside a lively exchange with Aoi (Inuyama Aoi) (E07-04), being the credulous recipient of Aoi's invented history in a V18 bonus strip (E18-19/20), and authoring a deliberate food-credibility hoax on Chiaki (Ōgaki Chiaki) and Aoi in V19 (E19-19). It separates bonus-strip and fantasy modes from main-story events (§8). A is rejected: bonus-strip chronology is not fixed, the account does not say when she jokes rather than stays earnest, and fantasy images of her belong to other characters. C would understate a differentiated account that includes her as both joker and target, with a contrary case.

The evidence is one active_provisional synthesis of the Japanese main manga V01-V19, read in full by the project's root reviewer and an independent reviewer, drawing on 144 collected observations (122 PRIMARY_VERIFIED, 22 ANALYSIS_EXTRACTED) with raw-image or EPUB-spine locators. B is rejected: V19 is not the manga's ending; 22 older records keep analysis-level status, including broad Oigawa logistics, early remote participation and some work and purchase history (§10); and the anime, anthologies and later volumes are outside the boundary. D would understate a dedicated, located synthesis over the whole admitted run.

The monograph records affirmative limits: consequential planning errors (the missed bus connection, the museum event a day late, the wrong turn to Takashita, the registration deadline; E16-03, E16-10, E16-12, E17-03); a corrected campsite-marker guess (E17-09); a burnt carrot (E07-03); a promised contact missed through sleep and a meal her father cooked instead (E19-12); no clear second solo overnight (E10-04/E11-03); Aoi's (Inuyama Aoi's) cycling and the V13 puncture sequence not hers (CR06); Ema's (Mizunami Ema's) repeat request not membership, and Mei's (Nakatsugawa Mei's) and Ema's paths not hers to claim (E14-03, E15-05, ER-001); and the rebuilt tower and the climb not completed (E19-13). A is rejected: limits are episode-located, not a census, and sustained conflict and ethics remain gaps rather than negative findings. C would understate a record that repeatedly marks what she did not do, know or cause.

Claims carry volume, literal raw-image or EPUB-spine locators and P or A status, with story epochs kept apart from later admission (the post-V19 complements stay in V04-V07 and V13 epochs) and with correction overlays (ER-001, ER-005, ER-006, CR06). The V16 spring special is placed before the Gunma chapters and is not a later reversal (E16-12). A is rejected: bonus-strip chronology is explicitly not fixed (§8), and the V03 and V10-V13 strands are ANALYSIS_EXTRACTED. C would understate a locator-bound account with explicit controls on what each state knows.

conditions: Illustrative Japanese only, never quotation, in short turns whose purpose and recipient are fixed before wording (an optional invitation, thanks, a hedge, an admission of error, a request for counsel, a playful host offer, an acknowledgment).

Register follows the attested relation: familiar with Rin (Shima Rin), Ena (Saitō Ena), Aoi (Inuyama Aoi) and Ema (Mizunami Ema); energetic polite forms to workplace adults and residents; playful elderly-host diction with children; plain warmth and apology within the family.
Energy does not imply confidence in the underlying fact, and a polite form among friends does not imply distance.

Main-story speech is kept apart from bonus-strip and fantasy modes; no self-reference rule, frequency claim, sustained conflict, formal setting, lengthy workplace exchange or extended negative affect.
scenario_readiness.note: Generated lines are noncanonical by nature. For short recipient-conditioned turns in sampled relations the evidence constrains the output; outside them it does not.

conditions: A bounded novel outing, meal or visit in one selected state, with a sampled companion and stated material conditions.

The response is given as a range: proposing or joining activity, contributing food or a plan, asking or accepting help, revising after a mismatch, and the real possibility of a planning error, missed information or fatigue.
Other people's contributions (driving, cooking, consent, knowledge) stay theirs, and recovery after a setback names its object.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One explicitly selected state, and nothing later: before the V07 solo trip (no solo experience; V05 delivery work and V06 counsel request only), after V07 (actual solo experience, mixed appraisal and the wish to alternate), the V16-V17 Gunma journey with Ena (Saitō Ena) and Ema (Mizunami Ema), or after the V19 household reunion. V19 is not the manga's ending.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Rin (Shima Rin), Ena, Aoi (Inuyama Aoi), Ema, Ayano (Toki Ayano) or a family member (Sakura (Kagamihara Sakura), mother, father) in their sampled roles. Chiaki (Ōgaki Chiaki) and Mei (Nakatsugawa Mei) only within sampled exchanges. Strangers at a campsite are sampled once (V07); a comparable stranger is a separate, lower-confidence transfer.
setting_constraints: Camping, rail, bus and walking travel, cooking experiments, household hospitality and short-term errands in a realistic contemporary Japanese setting with stated money, transport, timetables, services and fatigue
Outputs are ranges with alternatives; the evidence does not say when an interest will be acted on rather than left a wish
No sustained interpersonal conflict, romance, ethical dilemma, formal institutional setting or lengthy workplace exchange, and no setting or technology absent from the V01-V19 manga

scenario_readiness.note: Supported only as a range: the monograph's central pattern is explicitly not a prediction.

conditions: Sampled ordinary classes only: campsite cooking and food experiments, shared and solo camping, rail and walking travel, delivery errands, gear desire against price, family logistics and hosting guests at home, messaging and telephone contact.
Solo and group modes are both positive options for her; the solo preference adds to group life rather than replacing it.
Money, timetables, services, fatigue and other people's knowledge stay in force, and she can misplan, misjudge or fall asleep.
Wages, household finances, school life and lengthy workplace exchanges are outside these conditions.
scenario_readiness.note: This is the strongest-supported scenario: ordinary activity is the substance of the evidence, with other people's work and her errors kept visible.

Only local acts with an ethical aspect are located (asking consent for the dumplings, apologizing to her father, a bonus-strip hoax), and no deliberation is depicted. This limits use; it is not a finding that she lacks moral reasoning.

The monograph says repeated actor-specific exchanges do not resolve romance and that such broader claims keep the corpus's held or unsupported dispositions (§9); no romantic conduct is located. This limits use; friendship and affection are covered under MUNDANE_SOCIAL and CROSS_SCENARIO.

Work appears as one short-term New Year card delivery job with two brief adult exchanges (E05-08) and a telephone report of enjoying customer service (E06-04). The monograph calls the latter a report, not a performance audit, and says lengthy workplace exchanges are undercovered (§10). The polite work register is covered under DIALOGUE.

known_limits.statement: The evidence is an active_provisional synthesis through the Japanese main manga V19, the end of the authorized reading run and not the manga's ending. No state after V19 is established, and the anime and anthologies are excluded.

22 older observations keep ANALYSIS_EXTRACTED status, including the V03 lamp and remote-participation strands, broad Oigawa logistics, the V12 listener episode and the V14 opening with Ema (Mizunami Ema); other reading-level details, such as the V01 club joining, also keep analytical status. They support the account at analytical strength only.

Turning interest into revisable activity has moderate confidence and is explicitly not a prediction that every curiosity will be acted on or every plan repaired. The evidence does not say when an interest becomes action rather than a wish.

The rival explanation that many patterns follow from camping subject matter, episodic comedy and ensemble structure remains substantial; actor-specific exchanges support the character account without settling that rival.

Hospitality is distributed: her father cooks the V19 meal, Sakura (Kagamihara Sakura) drives, her mother consents, her grandmother provides, and Aoi (Inuyama Aoi) leads the Christmas dinner. Nadeshiko (Kagamihara Nadeshiko) organizes and hosts without being the source of everything.

Her planning errors have consequences for routes, timing, money and what companions must do (the missed bus, the missed museum event, the wrong turn, the registration deadline). Recovery, when it comes, is contingent on other people and services.
The Japanese samples are tied to recipients but are not a census. Self-reference, sustained conflict, unfamiliar formal settings, lengthy workplace exchanges and negative affect are undercovered.

Bonus strips, fantasy images and other characters' dreams of her do not add real events, jobs, abilities or knowledge, and the V19 food-credibility hoax is a bonus-strip case, not evidence of habitual dishonesty in the main story.

Nadeshiko (Kagamihara Nadeshiko) does not know Rin's (Shima Rin's) private praise, Ema's (Mizunami Ema's) unspoken doubts, Ayano's (Toki Ayano's) dream, or that Rin and Sakura (Kagamihara Sakura) checked on her V07 trip.

Her encouragement shapes the V07 girl's wish, not an enacted trip; Ema's (Mizunami Ema's) repeat request is not membership; and Mei's (Nakatsugawa Mei's) joining and the V15 advice to Ema belong to others.
Sustained interpersonal conflict and ethical deliberation are not sampled in this low-conflict corpus. This is a gap, not evidence that she cannot argue or reason morally.
No in-sample or held-out probe of a model of Nadeshiko (Kagamihara Nadeshiko) exists.
